name: 46340-sharegpt-30ba3b-4gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3, all four GPUs of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:4).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=4, expert parallelism ON, so ep_size = dp x tp = 4 and the 128 experts are split 32 per rank. All-to-all backend `deepep_low_latency`.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=500, warmup 50%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 2000 requests (four waves of the 500-row file) with an 1800 s safety cap; ~1500 requests scored. Seed static 46340.
workload: `configs/data/sharegpt-500-qwen3-30ba3b.jsonl`, 500 rows totalling 103437 prompt tokens, regenerated by `configs/data/make-dataset.py`; prompt tokens mean 206.9 (min 4, p50 76, max 975), output tokens mean 219.8 (min 4, p50 175, max 812). Sent as plain completions with no chat template; each row's output length is pinned and EOS ignored; sampling temperature 0.0.
purpose: A general chat assistant on a mixture-of-experts model, serving 500 concurrent short conversations across four GPUs.
launch:
# The engine is the source build named in configs/env.yaml. Nothing here is tuned.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B

# The topology is the declaration, not a knob. `deepep_low_latency` requires `deep_ep`
# importable in the venv; without it the engine will not start with this backend.
data-parallel-size: 4
enable-expert-parallel: true
all2all-backend: deepep_low_latency

dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
enforce-eager: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
# Everything else is the engine default: max-num-seqs, max-num-batched-tokens, prefix caching,
# TP=1, PP=1.
